coordinate_space: Final font units, ready to replay. Do not apply further horizontal scaling or stylization.
design_notes: Source-derived symbols retain original Source Han contour topology; optical scaling, pairing, stroke opening, and final rounding/chamfer are recorded here.
Six independently designed box glyphs join across a whole 900/850-unit cell and a 1480-unit baseline step. Line centre is y=380, ascent=1160, descent=-320.
Single guillemet left is the exact mirror of the existing final right glyph, with its advance and baseline retained.
Two-dot ellipsis retains existing ellipsis dot size and vertical position.
Original angle brackets and box geometry are independently drawn and distributed under OFL 1.1.
